name: Coca-Cola UNITED - Birmingham Production Plant, AL

fieldNotes.location: Roster geocode flagged 'moved 5725 m' but the supplied lat/lng (33.561277,-86.768222) is correct - it lands on the Coca-Cola UNITED Birmingham campus. Confirmed in Street View: a large red 'Coca-Cola' script logo is mounted on the building facing East Lake Blvd. This is the Coca-Cola Bottling Company UNITED corporate HQ + Birmingham Production Plant, 4600 E Lake Blvd, Birmingham AL 35217 - ~350,000 sq ft on ~39 acres, in operation since 1979, 750+ employees.
fieldNotes.campus: Multi-building HQ + production campus: a large sawtooth-roof production warehouse, a separate north warehouse, and an attached office complex. multipleFacilities=true.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Property is fenced; trucks enter via a service/truck drive off East Lake Blvd at the SW (separate from the office/visitor entrance to the east). Gate hardware not directly resolvable in overhead imagery; controlled entrance inferred from continuous fence and a distinct truck approach.
fieldNotes.truckGateCount: Two access points off East Lake Blvd - a SW truck/service drive and a SE office/visitor drive. Truck-relevant gate count ~2; flagged as approximate.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No clear freestanding beside-the-lane guard booth visible at the truck entrance in z20 imagery. A small structure sits near the SW service drive but reads as a utility/maintenance building, not a guard booth. guardShack=false at medium confidence.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Truck gate present, no guard shack identified -> remoteGs=true (kiosk/badge check-in implied). Medium confidence given this is a corporate HQ where staffed security is plausible.
fieldNotes.entryExitSeparate: Separate truck (SW) and office (SE) entrances; truck in/out likely shares the SW drive. entryExitSeparate set true on the campus-level distinct gates - flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: 50+ - extensive dock doors along the production warehouse SW face plus the north warehouse, trailers backed in at both. ~50 estimated, approximate.
fieldNotes.dropArea: 50+ trailers parked without tractors across the west and central trailer yards; large red Coca-Cola / UNITED fleet plus delivery trucks.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock banks on physically separate building faces (production warehouse SW face and the north warehouse) support separate ship/receive operations.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property. railServed=false.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Within Birmingham city limits beside I-59, surrounded by dense residential and industrial development - Urban.
fieldNotes.note: Coca-Cola UNITED announced (May 2024) a $330M new Birmingham facility; this audit covers the existing 4600 E Lake Blvd campus, which remains the active production plant.

citations.claim: Birmingham is UNITED's corporate HQ and an active sales/distribution location
$5M to repurpose the Birmingham production facility into warehouse/loading; production moved to other UNITED plants

verification.rationale: LABEL CORRECTION: Coca-Cola UNITED Birmingham is no longer a production plant (bottling pulled in 2020, now warehouse/distribution + HQ). Still a heavily active UNITED yard.
